status: human-approved design snapshot; application implementation pending
approval_scope: Final refined Recall preview, after removal of the redundant bottom selected-detail row.
source_policy: Frozen byte-for-byte copies of the approved inline source and its clean and tooltip screenshots. Do not format or overwrite frozen artifacts.
fixture_policy: Illustrative paired-review counts and percentages; not recovered screenshot counts and not a recalculation of live extension data. Exact observed fractions determine plotted observed percentages. Differences in the frozen source are precomputed before display rounding.

approved_visual_rules.observed: Solid mint line and circle markers; active circle radius 5px and stroke width 3px.
approved_visual_rules.fsrs: Opaque short-dashed line and diamond markers; active diamond radius 5px and stroke width 2px.
approved_visual_rules.missing_evidence: Long-dash bridges connect next measured points; missing buckets never get markers or invented values.
approved_visual_rules.inspection: One neutral selected-bucket guide and paired active markers; counts, rates, signed difference, target, full interval and as-of context appear only in the structured tooltip. No bottom selected-detail row and no between-point gap connector.
approved_visual_rules.sample_count_visibility: Shared paired-review cohort counts remain contextual when a series is hidden; hidden series rates and the comparison difference follow series visibility.
approved_visual_rules.dates: Sparse calendar MM/DD ticks. Append /YY outside the report year and both years for cross-year ranges. Tooltips and table retain full interval endpoints.
approved_visual_rules.unknowns: Unavailable counts and rates remain unavailable, not zero.
approved_visual_rules.controls: Native Chart/Table and series buttons, nearest-bucket pointer/touch selection, Left/Right keyboard navigation, Escape tooltip dismissal, and dynamic SVG accessibility description.

production_mapping.difference: Use serialized difference (fractional units) and multiply by 100 for percentage points. Do not subtract rounded displayed percentages.
production_mapping.scale: Use existing serialized adaptive percentage domain and ticks; 20–100% is this fixture, not a new fixed production scale.

checksum_policy: SHA-256 covers the four frozen artifacts. This metadata manifest is not self-hashed.
